events.title: SC Trip & Networking
events.description: Travel to South Carolina. Meet Kim Bowman at SCRIN, visit UofSC Office of Innovation, connect with Rep. Bradley's office.

events.title: Name Reservation Deadline
events.description: Reserve chosen nonprofit name with SC Secretary of State before the 120-day window expires.

events.title: File Articles of Incorporation
events.description: Submit Form NP to the SC Secretary of State to legally establish the nonprofit. Cost: $32.50.

events.title: Get EIN from IRS
events.description: Apply for Employer Identification Number on IRS.gov. Free and instant online.

events.title: Board Member Recruitment
events.description: Follow up with potential board members. Need 3 confirmed before organizational meeting.

events.title: Organizational Board Meeting
events.description: First official board meeting. Approve bylaws, elect directors, adopt conflict-of-interest policy, authorize bank account.

events.title: 501(c)(3) Application Filed
events.description: Submit IRS Form 1023-EZ or 1023 for federal tax-exempt status. Cost: $275–$600.

events.title: Google for Nonprofits Apply
events.description: Apply for Google for Nonprofits. Unlocks free Google Workspace and $10K/month in Ad Grants.

events.title: OpenAI Fund Opens
events.description: OpenAI People-First AI Fund application window opens. Priority Tier 1 grant — submit as soon as possible.

events.title: First Grant Application
events.description: Submit first major grant application to the OpenAI People-First AI Fund.

events.title: Google.org/aiEDU Opens
events.description: Google.org AI Education Rural Catalyst grant window opens. Submit application with pilot workshop evidence.

events.title: First AI Literacy Workshop
events.description: Host the inaugural AI literacy workshop in a rural South Carolina community.

events.title: 501(c)(3) Follow-Up
events.description: Check IRS processing status of 501(c)(3) application. Expected 3-6 month processing time.

events.title: Microsoft/OpenAI Fund Deadline
events.description: Deadline for Microsoft/OpenAI Societal Resilience Fund application. Requires workshop pilot data.

events.title: Workshop Series #2
events.description: Host second workshop in the pilot series. Gather feedback and document impact metrics.

events.title: 501(c)(3) Determination Expected
events.description: Expected receipt of IRS determination letter granting 501(c)(3) status. Unlocks major grant eligibility.

events.title: SC Tax Exemption Filing
events.description: File for SC state tax exemptions after receiving IRS determination letter. File Form ST-387 with SC DOR.

events.title: Charitable Solicitation Registration
events.description: File Registration Statement with SC Secretary of State to legally solicit charitable donations. Fee: $50.

events.title: NSF BPC Grant Window
events.description: NSF Broadening Participation in Computing grant cycle opens. Requires 501(c)(3) status.

events.title: Q4 Board Meeting
events.description: Quarterly board meeting. Review Q3 financials, grant pipeline, workshop outcomes, and Phase 2 planning.

events.title: USDA RBDG Application
events.description: USDA Rural Business Development Grant application deadline. Submit with pilot program outcome data.

events.title: First Major Grant Decision
events.description: Expected receipt of first major grant award (OpenAI People-First Fund or USDA RBDG).

events.title: Incubator Cohort 1 Launch
events.description: Launch inaugural cohort of the rural AI innovation incubator. Target: 8-12 rural SC entrepreneurs.

events.title: Incubator Applications Open
events.description: Open applications for the first incubator cohort. Market to rural SC communities and partner networks.

events.title: Demo Day — Cohort 1
events.description: First incubator Demo Day. Founders pitch AI startups to investors from VentureSouth, UCAN, and Palmetto Angel Fund.
